title: Public introduction
description: JSON Resume was discussed on Hacker News as a JSON-based open-source format for résumés.

title: First official specification release
description: Thomas Davis and Roland Sharp announced version 0.0.0 of the specification, alongside the CLI and modular theme system.

title: First announced service integration
description: The project announced that Represent had added an option to export profiles in JSON Resume format.

title: Community theme competition
description: The team announced a monthly theme competition with a $250 prize, sponsored by Hired.com.

title: Gist-based résumé hosting
description: The fifth-birthday update described a rewritten hosting service that used resume.json files stored in users’ GitHub Gists.
